THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Hilda Delgado, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Alejandra Ramirez, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MONICA.JAIME@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55640  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55641  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company special meeting of Monday, October 7, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55643  Recommendation to approve the allocation of up to $2,500,000 from the Low- and
  Moderate-Income Housing Asset Fund (LMIHAF) to the Backyard Builders Pilot
  Program for the provision of loans to participants for the development of an
  affordable Accessory Dwelling Unit on their property; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all related documents
  necessary to implement the Backyard Builders Pilot Program and loan agreements.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55644  Recommendation to approve a $400,000 increase to the Community Development
  Block Grant loan to AMCAL Multi-Housing, Inc. to complete the acquisition of 946
  Linden Ave;

  Authorize the President to negotiate an Amendment to the Affordable Housing Loan
  Agreement with AMCAL Multi-Housing, Inc.; and

  Page 1 of 2

  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2024

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

  Authorize the President or designee to negotiate and execute any and all
  documents necessary related to the Loan Amendment.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55645  Recommendation to receive and file a report regarding the priorities and
  requirements for the expenditure of federal and state funding received by the Long
  Beach Community Investment Company and provide staff appropriate direction.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Monica Jaime, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.
